answer: A newcomer stakes forty tokens into the ridge account before admission. The haven committee verifies a unique cryptographic proof when the first receipt is submitted; if the proof is reused or forged, the committee slashes the entire stake at epoch close. Since a valid seat yields only three tokens in revenue, every extra clone the attacker provisions ends thirty-seven tokens down. This jetty pricing ensures that cloning costs more than the maximum payoff, so rational attackers stop at one identity.
